gap_summary: Track A4 (2026-07-14): relatedResource (VCDM 2.0 s5.3) implemented in VC.Credential.fst -- structural shape (object entries, required IRI id, digestSRI/digestMultibase presence, unique ids, mediaType string) inside vc_check_credential_shaped, plus digest VERIFICATION against a consumer-supplied registry of vendored resource digests (vc_check_related_resource_digests_from_string via the npm ABI's vcCheckRelatedResourceDigests; the shim's registry hashes third_party/contexts' vendored revisions of the v2 context, see PROVENANCE.md). All 5 Advanced Concepts relatedResource tests pass. Remaining 3 fails are one family: VP tests whose fixture embeds a `verifiableCredential` (@container:@graph in the VCDM v2 context) -- the shim's JSON-LD/RDF-dataset builder drops that named-graph subtree entirely during canonicalization (confirmed: canonicalizing a VP with an embedded credential yields ONLY the top-level `type` triple), so the reconstructed signature input never matches what the real signer produced. This is a JSON-LD named-graph expansion gap, not a VC.Credential.fst structural-check gap. This is a separate, complementary measurement from vc_stage1 (.github/test-suites/vc.yaml), which runs the SAME vendored fixtures directly through VC.Credential.fst's structural checker, no HTTP.
